verdict.rationale: Gusto documents a public REST API in depth. The docs cover authentication with system access tokens, header-based versioning, pagination, idempotency keys, optimistic-concurrency version fields with 409 conflicts, and structured JSON errors. They also include concrete endpoint references for payrolls, contractor payments, time off and webhook subscriptions, plus official client libraries and Postman collections. Agent-oriented access is reinforced by an official remote MCP server for a customer's own account and a public agent-friendly CLI that calls api.gusto.com. Missing for 10: independent hands-on or community corroboration of driving the REST API directly; the API docs centre on the partner-oriented Embedded Payroll product rather than a general API for a customer's own account.
